attchmntText: NAVA LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Nava Limited has uploaded the audio recording of its investor conference call held on November 12, 2026, at 04.00 pm IST. The call discussed the operational and financial performance for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The recording is available on the company website at the specified URL.

attchmntText: NAVA LIMITED has informed the Exchange about "Presentation for the quarter ended 30.09.2026"
voiceSummary: Nava Limited filed an investor presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated operational revenue for Q2 FY27 was Rs. 1,252 Cr, up 29.9% year-on-year. Consolidated EBITDA stood at Rs. 561 Cr, a 64.4% increase, with an EBITDA margin of 42.0%. Consolidated profit after tax was Rs. 403 Cr, doubling year-on-year. Earnings per share were Rs. 11.14. For the first half of FY27, consolidated revenue was Rs. 2,464.1 Cr, up 14.2%, and PAT was Rs. 736.3 Cr, up 27.7%. Earnings per share for the half year were Rs. 20.93. Maamba Energy Limited declared a dividend of US$ 15.0 Mn in October 2026. Nava Bharat Projects Limited paid a dividend of Rs. 8.2 Cr during the quarter. Maamba Solar’s 100 MW project was commissioned on September 24, 2026.

attchmntText: NAVA LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Press release".
voiceSummary: Nava Limited announced unaudited financial results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations reached 1,252 crore rupees, a 30% year-on-year increase. Profit after tax rose 127% year-on-year to 403 crore rupees. The company commissioned a 100 MW solar power project in Zambia. Phase II of MEL's 300 MW power expansion is targeted for full commissioning by July 2027. Avocado commercial harvest is scheduled from November 2026 to March 2027. The integrated sugar project aims for commercial operations in fiscal year 2028-29. Exploration for manganese and lithium continues in Côte d'Ivoire and Zambia. The company recovered arrears from the utility in Zambia.

attchmntText: NAVA LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Auditors of the company.
voiceSummary: Nava Limited recommended the appointment of B S R and Co, Chartered Accountants, as Statutory Auditors. This recommendation was made by the Board of Directors on November 12, 2026, following the Audit Committee's review. The proposed term is five consecutive years, starting from the conclusion of the 55th Annual General Meeting in 2027 and ending with the 60th Annual General Meeting in 2032. The appointment is subject to shareholder approval. The current auditors, Walker Chandiok & Co LLP, will retire after their second consecutive five-year term concludes at the 2027 meeting. B S R and Co has Firm Registration Number 128510W.

attchmntText: NAVA LIMITED has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Nava Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board recommended the appointment of B S R and Co, Chartered Accountants, as Statutory Auditors for a term of five years from the conclusion of the 55th Annual General Meeting in 2027 to the conclusion of the 60th Annual General Meeting in 2032. This appointment is subject to approval by the Members of the Company. The Board meeting was held on November 12, 2026. Walker Chandiok & Co LLP issued review reports on the consolidated and standalone financial results, noting no material misstatements. The reports highlight a contingent liability related to a lawsuit involving subsidiary Brahmani Infratech Private Limited. Interim financial information for seven subsidiaries, not reviewed by their auditors, reflects total assets of 3,204.32 lakhs as at September 30, 2026.
